# intn_sale_agreement

Customer agreement types linked to pricelists. Automatically applies the agreement pricelist on sale orders.

**Grupo:** `intn_sales` · **Versión:** 18.0.1.0.1 · **Categoría:** Sales

**Depende de:** `intn_portal_registration`, `intn_product_organization`, `product`, `rf_customer_registration`, `sale`
